cards.title: The boot rail
items: MicroProfile Config ordinals decide the winner: system properties 400 > environment 300 > microprofile-config.properties 100 — an env-first policy needs a custom ConfigSource, it does not happen by default
secrets come from a vault or a Kubernetes Secret, never from the properties file, persistence.xml, the logs or the image; a missing required key fails the boot fast
the composition root builds the CDI graph — constructor injection, producers returning port types, no field injection and no service locator in business code

cards.title: Deploy is a step, not a startup
items: Flyway or Liquibase runs as an init job before the rollout — never on application start, where two replicas would race the same migration
server configuration is code (image, Helm, Ansible), never an admin console; the nodes are stateless and the rolling deploy gates on readiness
expand/contract migrations and a tested rollback: the built WAR or EAR starts on the target server, not only in the unit suite

cards.title: Health, metrics, shutdown
items: MicroProfile Health exposes readiness and liveness; the readiness gate is what the rolling deploy waits on, and a failing database answers 503 instead of serving broken traffic
Metrics cover latency, errors, queue depth and age, outbox and DLQ counts and pool saturation; OpenTelemetry traces carry the correlationId from HTTP through JMS and the outbox
structured logs carry tenantId, slice and use case — never a token or PII; on SIGTERM the in-flight requests drain and the worker settles its outbox rows
